An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>", new ConversionOptions());
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
```
